answer: One strong defence is a bonded, non-transferable work history: an agent must earn standing by completing verifiable tasks over time, like a willow taking root rather than a dune shifting overnight. New identities start in a sparse meadow of low trust, able to do small jobs but not vote or move funds. An attacker spawning thousands of fresh identities gains nothing, because each one must slowly accumulate costly, checkable proof of useful work before it can influence the economy.
